research_rationale:
Executive Order 13902 of January 10, 2020 (85 FR 2003), Imposing Sanctions With Respect to Additional Sectors of Iran, has thirteen sections. The held Federal Register text layer (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13902.txt, 85 FR 2003, PDF pages 1-4) carries the heading, the date January 10, 2020 and FR Doc. 2020-00534. The dossier's own-text boundary is flagged unverified and its 39 clause spans cut some sentences in the middle (for example a fragment beginning '(a)(i) of this section;' and another beginning '(a) of this section, the Secretary'), so the inventory is corrected to 23 clauses with exact spans: the lead that orders further steps under the Executive Order 12957 emergency; section 1 (blocking, its four criteria and the exception clause); section 2 (foreign financial institution sanctions in (a) to (c)); section 3 (entry suspension); section 4 (donations); section 5 (what the prohibitions include); section 6 (evasion and conspiracy); section 7 (definitions); section 8 (no prior notice); section 9 (delegation); section 10 (general provisions); section 11 (exemption for agricultural commodities, food, medicine and medical devices); section 12 (United Nations business); and section 13 (measures respond to post-Algiers Accords actions). The order states no end date or condition. The emergency was continued each March through the notice of March 2, 2026, and an OFAC rule of October 13, 2026 publishes a sector determination made under section 1(a)(i) on October 1, 2026. Executive Order 14382 of 2026 recites this order among the further steps under the same emergency and neither revokes nor amends it. A search of the held corpus for the number EO 13902 (25 files) finds the order, continuation notices, OFAC notices and rules, 31 CFR part 560 and Executive Order 14382; none revokes, supersedes or amends it. The status on 2026-10-14 is operative for all 23 clauses. The held text is a machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF; page images were not inspected.

An OFAC rule of 2026-10-13 applies section 1(a)(i) on a determination made 2026-10-01.
